headline: Brent Crude Edges Higher to $92 on Middle East Supply Concerns
summary: Brent crude futures rose 0.3% to $92.22 per barrel amid supply concerns triggered by Houthi attacks on Riyadh and reports of shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is the world's most critical oil transit chokepoint, and physical disruptions or military strikes in Saudi Arabia immediately inject geopolitical risk premiums into global energy prices.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Crude futures rose to $92.22 on concerns of disruption to Saudi infrastructure and Hormuz shipping routes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Oil prices gained as market participants priced in potential supply interruptions following attacks targeting Riyadh and shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.
